findings.title: Empty updateMany data will throw and break cache warming
findings.body: fetchAvailabilityAndSetCache calls SelectedCalendarRepository.updateManyByCredentialId(this.credential.id, {}) with empty data. Prisma updateMany requires a non-empty data object and throws a validation error for {}. This means every call to fetchAvailabilityAndSetCache will throw after writing cache, breaking watch/unwatch flows. Fix by passing an explicit touch like { updatedAt: new Date() }.

findings.title: Cache status not refreshed after delete
findings.body: deleteCacheMutation onSuccess only shows a toast and calls the optional onSuccess prop, while disconnectMutation invalidates viewer.calendars.connectedCalendars and viewer.apps.integrations. After Delete cached data succeeds the connectedCalendars query still holds the old cacheUpdatedAt, so the UI keeps showing Last updated and the delete option until a manual reload. Invalidate connectedCalendars on delete success.

findings.title: Cache status includes expired rows
findings.body: getCacheStatusByCredentialIds groups all calendarCache rows by credentialId with max(updatedAt) and no expiresAt filter, while getCachedAvailability only serves rows with expiresAt >= now. The UI will therefore show Cache Status / Last updated for cache that will never be hit and offer Delete for unusable data. Filter to non-expired rows.

findings.title: Generic Error instead of TRPCError
findings.body: deleteCacheHandler throws new Error("Credential not found or access denied") when the credential is not owned by the caller. A plain Error becomes INTERNAL_SERVER_ERROR, hiding NOT_FOUND vs FORBIDDEN and preventing correct client handling. Use TRPCError with code NOT_FOUND or FORBIDDEN.

findings.title: Bypasses disabled-cache mock and always hits DB
findings.body: connectedCalendarsHandler directly instantiates new CalendarCacheRepository() instead of using the CalendarCache factory/mock that returns empty when calendar-cache is disabled. This forces a calendarCache.groupBy query on every connectedCalendars fetch even when caching is disabled and can surface cache status when the feature is off. Reuse the same enabled-check/factory used elsewhere.

findings.title: macOS-only sed breaks script on Linux
findings.body: The script updates .env with sed -i '' -E, which is BSD/macOS syntax. On GNU/Linux sed -i '' treats '' as a filename and fails, so GOOGLE_WEBHOOK_URL is never updated in containers/CI which are Linux. Use a portable update or branch on OS.

findings.title: Env path relative to cwd not script
findings.body: ENV_FILE is set to ../.env relative to the current working directory. If run from the repo root as scripts/test-gcal-webhooks.sh it resolves outside the repo and creates/updates the wrong file. Resolve relative to the script directory.

findings.title: dev:cron uses npx tsx without dependency
findings.body: dev:cron was changed from ts-node to npx tsx but tsx is not in dependencies or devDependencies. Every invocation will fetch tsx from the network, making the script slow, non-hermetic, and a supply-chain risk. Add tsx as a devDependency or revert.

findings.title: Hard-coded en-US date format ignores locale
findings.body: Cache timestamp is formatted with new Intl.DateTimeFormat("en-US", ...) instead of the user's locale from useLocale. Non-US users will see MM/DD/YYYY short dates inconsistent with the rest of the app. Pass the current locale.
